name: Touka
source:
He is so beautiful that there is no one in the town who does not know him. Lives in the only inn in town, the Seikaro, where he often helps out. He also serves at a ryotei, and crowds of people sometimes gather there at lunchtime to catch a glimpse of him.

[Translated from [url=http://lovedelivery.biz/suito/chara.html]the official website[/url].]
